JOURNAL · append-only JSON lines
in = every inbox event, incl. full model, perception and tool outputs
step = rules fired, slot writes, relevance / outcome / operation changes
out = actions with caused_by, rule, key, argument provenance
metrics = first-speech latency, cancel latency, step duration

ANSWERING THE JURY
Why this call now? out.caused_by → step rules → the in-record that triggered it
Why was c1 ignored? step at seq 7: recorded, not used, SUPERSEDED at seq 5
Rule-name prefixes
T0 = fast understanding · REL = relevance
REC = reconcile · ADM = result admission
k(...) = content key: tool + argument values
